Author: Pankaj Purohit Bench: Pankaj Purohit  Office Notes,
 reports, orders or SL. proceedings or  Date COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS No directions and  Registrar's order

with Signatures  WPCRL No.519 of 2025  Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vikas Guglani, learned counsel for petitioner.
2. Mr. S.C. Dumka, learned A.G.A. with Ms. Sweta Badola Dobhal, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand/ respondent Nos.1 and 2.

3. By means of the present writ petition, petitioner has challenged the impugned FIR No.89 of 2025 dated 01.04.2025, for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 IPC, registered at P.S. Sitarganj, District Udham Singh Nagar.

4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that he is working as Assistant Teacher with the Education Department of the State and for the same set of allegations, he has been suspended and subsequently, his services were terminated.
Now, on the same set of facts, the first information report has been lodged and the petitioner is apprehending arrest.
5. Per contra, learned State Counsel vehemently opposed the interim prayer on the ground that petitioner has obtained government job on the basis of alleged forged documents.

6. I have gone through the FIR and find that the dispute is with regard to the genuineness of degree of B.Ed., obtained by him from Deendayal Upadhyay University, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, hence,
the matter requires deliberation.
7.
Issue notice to the respondent no.3, returnable within four weeks.

8. Steps to be taken within a week.
9.
Meanwhile, respondents may file the counter affidavit.

1 11.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive measures shall be taken against the petitioner, pursuant to the impugned FIR, provided he cooperates with the investigation.
12. Interim relief application (IA/1/2025) stands disposed of accordingly.
